title: Effect of Fluorochemicals on Flame-Retardant Fibers
authors: Nishkam Kasturiya; Priyanka Katiyar; G. S. Bhargava; Anita Nishkam
source_version: Publisher original version, complete indexed PDF text
TGA_specimen_preparation: Preweighed 5 mg fabric sample placed in a crucible holder suspended from precision springs; crucible material, cutting or grinding, TG conditioning, replicate count, and scan endpoints are not specified.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863-77; limiting oxygen index by top ignition with adjusted oxygen/nitrogen valves to maintain a candle-like flame; instrument model not specified
LOI_specimen_preparation: Condition at 65 ± 2% relative humidity and 27 ± 2 °C for 48 h; top ignition; mean of 10 replicates. LOI specimen dimensions and uncertainty are not stated.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Own Table 1/2 initial control LOI and Table 5/6 initial phase I degradation temperature; source prose explicitly describes initiation/onset.
conditions_locator: Experimental p 247; LOI and TGA methods p 248
source_location: Complete original 10-page publisher PDF indexed text, printed pp 245–254, all Tables 1–6, methods, results, conclusion and references. PDF bytes and table screenshots unavailable; no pixel claim.
sample_state: Control Trevira CS; Untreated fabric control; initial LOI row; no fluorochemical finish or durability leaching assigned
washing_state: Untreated control; no durability leaching assigned; exact control pretreatment not separately specified
treatment_chemistry: No applied fluorochemical coating; inherently flame-retardant fiber fabric control
treatment_method: Imported inherently flame-retardant fibers were woven into the specified plain fabric at Bhilwara Processors, Bhilwara, Rajasthan. The treatment subsection washes samples in 5 g/L soda/soap at 50 °C for 30 min before finishing, but does not separately state whether controls receive that prewash. Control-specific prewash and drying are therefore left unresolved.
limitations: Two untreated fabric controls proposed; independent source QA required. All 14 treated TG rows are held because the evaluation preamble mentions 30 and 60 min leaching while Tables 5/6 do not identify initial versus leached TG states; no treated wash state is inferred. Canonical Tonset records the source initial phase I degradation temperature, expressly called initiation/onset in the respective prose, without reassigning it to T5 or another loss threshold. The operational tangent or threshold criterion is not reported. Source peak temperatures are retained only in raw fields because no explicit maximum-rate or DTG definition is given. Phase weight-loss values are not residue: Table 5 has the ambiguous header Final Phase I Residue % Weight Loss, whereas prose calls the values weight loss. No percentage is subtracted from 100 or transferred to a canonical residue. End-of-stage temperatures are not TG scan endpoints. Exact control prewash remains unspecified. LOI replicate count is 10 and values are means; no SD is reported. TGA replication, crucible material and scan endpoints are unreported. The original printed DOI omits a digit relative to publisher URL and Crossref registration; both forms are preserved, with the registered DOI canonical. Related January 2003 paper on the same fabrics concerns liquid repellency and has no own LOI/TGA found in its original methods or full-text term search; no methods or numeric metrics are borrowed. PDF bytes and screenshots were unavailable; cached original indexed text is the evidence and its hash is not a PDF hash.
composition: Inherently flame-retardant polyester Trevira CS from Hoechst, Germany; 84 ends/in, 74 picks/in; warp and weft 15 tex, 2-ply
source_phase_TG_raw: Phase I final temperature 564.07 °C; phase I header value 85.27 described as degradation/weight loss; further phase II 14.21% degradation in prose. None mapped to residue.
TG_locator: Table 5 and corresponding TGA prose, p 252
source_material_form_TGA_raw: TGA method explicitly measures fabric samples; Table 5 and corresponding TGA prose, p 252
pairing_evidence: The untreated control for the named fabric has measured initial LOI 28.0 in Table 1 control, p 249, and initial phase I degradation temperature 414.76 °C in Table 5 and corresponding TGA prose, p 252. Both methods explicitly use the corresponding fabric; the control LOI after-leaching columns are dashes, so no durability state is assigned.
source_title: Effect of Fluorochemicals on Flame-Retardant Fibers
